description: This file contains utility functions for processing user attributes, including handling simple and select attributes, updating database records via Prisma transactions, and removing attributes.

methods.name: processUserAttributes
methods.description: Processes a list of user attributes, handling each based on its type, and updates the database accordingly.

methods.name: handleSimpleAttribute
methods.description: Handles updating or creating a simple attribute for a user in the database.

methods.name: handleSelectAttribute
methods.description: Handles updating or creating select-type attributes for a user, supporting single and multi-select.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from a user in the database.
